## Summary
Complete website redesign for flagship quality - clean, animated, light, minimalist design with better content organization.

## Changes

### Homepage
- Hero: Animated floating gradient orbs background
- New How It Works strip: 3-step flow (Book, We Clean, You Relax)
- Gallery: Carousel replaced with filterable grid (7 category filters)
- Reviews: Updated to responsive grid, added real Google reviews
- Why Choose Us: Staggered entrance animations
- Footer: Sitemap-style link columns (Services, Company, Areas)

### New Pages
- results.html: 61 before/after photos in filterable grid with 8 categories
- reviews.html: Google reviews page with rating summary
- about.html: Company story, values, how it works, animated stats

### Services Page
- Grouped 20 services into 5 categories:
  - Deep Cleaning (4)
  - Appliances and Kitchen (5)
  - Upholstery and Fabrics (5)
  - Floors and Exteriors (2)
  - Specialty and Commercial (4)

### Navigation and SEO
- Updated nav with links to new pages (Results, Reviews, About)
- Updated mobile menu
- Added new pages to sitemap.xml
- All pages have proper meta tags, OG tags, structured data

## Deployment
GitHub Pages auto-deploys from main branch.
